item.title: Louisiana marks Take Down Tobacco Day to help stop youth from vaping
item.description: The Louisiana Campaign for Tobacco-Free Living is joining a nationwide effort to observe Take Down Tobacco Day on April 1, 2026, in order to raise awareness about the dangers of youth vaping and nicotine use.

item.title: Wednesday Forecast: Dry and even warmer!
item.description: emperatures will get even warmer for the rest of the work week as the dry weather pattern continues. Cooler air returns to the area this weekend, and rain finally returns next week.

item.title: Caddo Middle Magnet names Kathryn Ferguson as new principal
item.description: Kathryn Ferguson has been appointed as the new principal of Caddo Middle Magnet, the top-performing middle school in Louisiana, and will transition into the role this spring.

item.title: SPD arrests armed buglary suspect hiding under porch
item.description: Shreveport police identified Keshawn Grady, 22, as the suspect in an armed burglary of a vehicle in the 3700 block of Fairfield Avenue.

item.title: NASA announces plans to build $20 billion moon base
item.description: NASA is investing approximately $20 billion over the next seven years to build a base on the moon's surface, repurposing equipment and international partner commitments from its original lunar gateway station plan.

item.title: Cautious canine Phineas blossoms at Marshall Pet Adoption Center
item.description: Phineas, a sweet dog at the Marshall Pet Adoption Center, is learning to trust humans after being rescued from a pack of almost 10 with no prior human interaction, and has become a lead dog in play groups despite a parvo diagnosis.

item.title: Natchitoches deputies threatened; gun and drugs seized in stop
item.description: During a traffic stop in Natchitoches Parish, authorities seized a loaded handgun, 51 suspected ecstasy tablets, 6 grams of marijuana, and drug paraphernalia from a vehicle, and arrested the driver and passenger for various charges including resisting an officer and possession of drugs and firearms.

item.title: LSU Shreveport scholars present research in Hawaii
item.description: LSU Shreveport scholars attended the 24th annual International Conference on Education in Hawaii to present 13 different pieces of research and network with other scholars.

item.title: Shreve Memorial Library selects new executive director
item.description: Shreve Memorial Library has appointed its new executive director, who is passionate about library advocacy.

item.title: Minden invites community to join Love the Boot Week cleanup
item.description: The City of Minden and Minden Main Street District are inviting the public to join them during Love the Boot Week, Louisiana's statewide litter removal and beautification effort, April 18-26, 2026, with a kick-off party at Miller Quarters Park on April 24th.

item.title: Iconic Louisiana restaurant names female culinary operations director for the first time
item.description: Galatoire's Restaurant has appointed Louisiana native Nicole Theriot as its first female director of culinary operations, making her the first woman to lead the kitchen in the restaurant's 120-year history.

item.title: Human Trafficking convict arrested in Sabine Parish for sex offender law breach
item.description: Jovan Martin, a registered sex offender with a conviction for Human Trafficking, was arrested in Sabine Parish for failing to comply with Louisiana's sex offender registration requirements.

item.title: 'Rolling shootout' near Kings Hwy & I-49; Man nearby says what he heard
item.description: A suspect opened fire on another car near Kings Highway and Interstate-49 in Shreveport, Louisiana, and a man was dropped off at a hospital with a gunshot wound shortly after the incident.
